meta.ogTitle: Paint. Sip. Feel the Ambience. — Curaçao’s sunset experience

hero.sub: Golden-hour doormat painting, island bites, crafted drinks and a live DJ — at a historic landhuis in Saliña, Willemstad.

story.title: Don’t buy a memory of Curaçao. Make one.
story.p1: Fridge magnets fade into a drawer. A doormat you painted yourself — under the palms, drink in hand, as the Caribbean sun sinks behind Willemstad — greets you every single time you come home.
story.p2: Ambience is a three-hour sunset evening for adults: a guided painting session anyone can do, island bites, a bar that knows what it’s doing and a DJ who reads the room. Come as a couple, a crew or solo. Leave with the one thing from your trip you’ll actually use.
story.imgAlt: Cocktail at sunset under the palm trees in Curaçao

exp.title: Your evening, beautifully curated.
exp.c1: Pick a design — tropical leaves, a Curaçao skyline, your family name, “Bon Bini” — or freestyle it. Our hosts guide you step by step. Zero talent required, stencils and all materials included.
exp.c1alt: Guest painting a design during a paint and sip evening
exp.c2: Start with a welcome drink, then order from the bar as the sky turns gold. Upgrade your table with a bites platter, a bottle of your favourite liquor or a hookah.
exp.c2alt: Friends toasting with cocktails in Curaçao
exp.c3: Afro-Caribbean grooves, soulful house and feel-good classics — our DJ and MC keep the energy warm, never overwhelming. It’s a party you can still talk through.
exp.c3alt: DJ playing a sunset set on a controller

flow.title: How the night unfolds
flow.t1d: Check in at the landhuis, grab your welcome drink and find your spot at the long table.
flow.t2d: Choose your stencil or sketch your own. Your host demonstrates the technique, then it’s brushes up.
flow.t3d: The sun drops, the string lights come on, the DJ turns it up a notch. This is the photo moment.
flow.t4d: Platters land on the table, hookahs glow, and your doormat gets its final details.
flow.t5d: Your doormat is dry, wrapped and suitcase-ready. The night in Willemstad is still young.

loc.title: A landhuis evening in Saliña
loc.p: Curaçao’s landhuizen are its grand 18th-century country houses. Ours sits in Saliña, the lively heart of Willemstad — ten minutes from Punda, Pietermaai and the cruise terminals, fifteen from Jan Thiel and Mambo Beach.
loc.l1: Thursday to Sunday · check-in 5:00 PM · experience 5:30 – 8:30 PM
loc.l2: Landhuis in Saliña, Willemstad, Curaçao. Exact address and parking details arrive with your confirmation.
loc.l3: Free parking on site. Taxis from most hotels take 10 – 15 minutes; we’re happy to arrange your ride back.
loc.alt: Willemstad waterfront in Curaçao lit up at night

items.a: Ambience is a sunset paint & sip experience in Willemstad, Curaçao. In three hours you design and paint your own coir doormat while enjoying drinks, island bites and a live DJ at a historic landhuis in Saliña. It runs Thursday to Sunday from 5:30 to 8:30 PM, with check-in at 5:00 PM.

Tickets are ${pp} per person. A group of {groupSize} pays ${group} in total. Your ticket includes the doormat, all materials, guidance, a welcome drink and the DJ / MC entertainment. Table upgrades with hookah, bites and a bottle are optional.

items.q: Do I need to be good at painting?
items.a: Not at all. We work with stencils and a simple dabbing technique, and your host guides every step. Most guests have never painted before — and every doormat goes home looking great.
Yes. Ambience is an adults-only evening with alcohol and hookah service, so all guests must be {age} or older. Please bring a valid ID.

items.q: Can I take my doormat on the plane?
items.a: Yes. The doormat measures 40 × 60 cm, fits flat in a standard suitcase and weighs about 1.5 kg. The paint is dry by the end of the night and we wrap it for travel.

items.q: I’m visiting by cruise ship. Can I join?
items.a: If your ship stays in port for the evening — yes. The landhuis is about ten minutes by taxi from the Mega Pier and Mathey Wharf. Please check your all-aboard time before booking; the experience ends at 8:30 PM.

items.q: How many people can join per evening?
items.a: We keep it intimate: a maximum of {cap} guests per evening. Popular dates sell out, so we recommend booking before you fly.
Curaçao is sunny most of the year and showers pass quickly. The landhuis has covered terraces, so the evening goes ahead. If we ever have to cancel, you choose between a new date and a full refund.

items.q: Can I cancel or change my booking?
items.a: You can reschedule or cancel free of charge up to 48 hours before your evening. Within 48 hours bookings are non-refundable, but you’re welcome to give your seat to someone else.
Island chic. We provide aprons, but acrylic paint is permanent — maybe leave the white linen for another night.
